interpretation: The fixed kernel and execution contract completed, but no tested seed learned the natural-start normal route. This is a normal-route learnability failure under the declared curriculum and optimization contract, not evidence about mutant discovery.

training_rollout_diagnostic.meaning: The uniform shortened-start mixture produced successful training episodes, so the frozen natural-start failure does not show that every suffix behavior was absent. Stage labels were not logged, so this does not localize the successful starts.

timing.limitation: The queue did not timestamp its predecessor validation and test start. The previously reported 23:11-23:22 window crossed two later no-op replays; it is not the first invocation duration. Replayed summary timing fields are not used.

replay_incident.cause: The central host watcher continued treating the scientifically failed but execution-complete queue as its desired GPU queue and relaunched it after normal exit.
replay_incident.effect: Checkpoints and updates were reused without retraining, but summary timing fields, capacity histories, gate_result.json, and queue.log were rewritten or appended.
replay_incident.stopped_by: The supported server-management registration command switched ext_csv to the idle CPU/GPU queue pair.

evidence_archive.verification: cmp queue.log and diff -qr over the full source and archive trees both returned success immediately after the copy.
evidence_archive.note: The archive preserves the full append-only queue log, including the first invocation, and the original updates/checkpoints. Summary-like files had already been replayed before archival and must not be used for wall-clock timing.

storage_at_archive.decision: Keep the archive and all continuation checkpoints on RAID; do not start a large checkpoint run under /home/ext_csv.

next_gate: One fixed-only backward-curriculum diagnostic. Mutant training, model-width changes, BC comparisons, and horizon changes remain closed.
